title: D3.js
summary: Hand-made data diagrams on the soot wall: torn-paper bars and strips, marker lines that draw themselves and boil, pencil hatching, tape, stamps and typewritten labels. Use them full-screen as cutaways, or pass "clear": true to float the diagram over footage on its own torn backing sheet.
usage: {"piece": "d3/bar-chart", "props": {"title": "…", "items": […]}}. Shared card chrome: library/themes/grunge/d3/pieces/_card.js. Files: library/themes/grunge/d3/pieces/.

items.name: Bar chart
items.description: Torn-paper bars pasted up from a marker baseline; the highlighted one is red, the rest bone with pencil hatching.

items.name: Line chart
items.description: A red marker line drawn across hand-ruled axes with hatching under it; the last point is circled in lime and tagged.

items.name: Torn pie
items.description: A ring torn from different papers, each slice pasted down in turn, with a typed legend.

items.name: Scatter
items.description: Crosses marked on hand-ruled axes, a red trend line dragged through them, one point circled and tagged.

items.name: Brush bars
items.description: Loaded brush strokes dragged along hatched tracks, one per measure, the first in red.

items.name: Ranking
items.description: Paper strips taped to the wall, longest first; the winner is red.

items.name: Big number
items.description: One figure counted up in huge worn capitals, its label on a lime marker stroke, a rubber stamp slammed in the corner.

items.name: Versus
items.description: Two torn sheets, bone against red, each with one big figure; a round stamp slams between them.

items.name: Tally marks
items.description: Counted the way you count on a wall: marker strokes in fives, every fifth struck through in red.

items.name: Timeline
items.description: A marker line down the wall with dates on torn tags and a typed note beside each.

items.name: Checklist
items.description: Hand-drawn boxes ticked off in red one by one; the step just done sits on a lime stroke.

items.name: Ledger
items.description: A typewritten ledger on a taped-up page: rows typed in, one highlighted in lime, the bottom line circled in red.
